answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested epoch payouts: agent rewards lock and release linearly over 36 epochs, so an identity like dune must survive months of honest work before earnings become liquid. A flash farm - atlas, sable - captures only one or two vesting cycles; when abandoned or flagged, the unvested 95 percent of rewards is slashed back to the treasury. Attacker cost per fake identity (collateral, keys, compute) then exceeds recoverable revenue, while honest long-lived agents collect the tail. Hit-and-run stops paying by construction.
